description: Payment checks (SPEC.md §22, Payment check): the status of `invoice`, which has no address (expiresAt = date + expiry; `received` is "0", `rest` null) from the LUD-21 answer to its verify URL, at `now`, or the error. The grace period ends at expiresAt + 120. `bodyText`: the body as sent, when it is not a JSON value written as such: one leading byte order mark is ignored (SPEC.md §15); JSON as SPEC.md §2 reads it (of two members with one name, the last counts; a number of any length is a double; a name may hold U+0000; no more than 64 arrays and objects nested; nothing else is JSON). `stored`: invoices as a shop stores them, checked before a payment check asks anything (SPEC.md §22): valid, or the error.
